segments.text: When dealing with new patients or patient referrals, you need to ask not only what medication they're currently taking but why they're taking it. Many doctors assume that patients understand the reasons for their course of treatment, but some patients may have been asked for their course of treatment.
have been prescribed these drugs a long time ago, and despite their prior doctor no doubt
outlining the reasons why such drugs are needed, patients can forget or misremember the actual
reason why these prescriptions are necessary to them. Make sure you go through this at
the earliest convenience. So a good way to start these discussions is to ask, can you
tell me what you're currently taking and what it's for?
